content.summary: Cannabis, metals, space and health care led ETF gains last week. WEED, CNBS, SIL, UFO, GDXJ, PLTM and OZEM outperformed despite tech weakness.

content.summary: Platinum (PLTM, PPLT), Palladium (PALL), Lithium (LITP), and Silver (SLVR) ETFs all jumped 10%+ last week despite weak Wall Street.

content.title: Platinum ETF (PLTM) Hits New 52-Week High
content.summary: PLTM hits a 52-week high, which is up 65.8% from lows, fueled by platinum supply crunch & surging demand. More gains ahead?

content.title: 5 Best-Performing ETF Areas of June
content.summary: In June, KDEF surged 21.7% as Korean defense exports gained steam, while PLTM soared 23.2% on platinum's tightening supply.

content.title: 6 Best-Performing ETF Areas of Second Quarter 2025
content.summary: Crypto, defense, uranium, and AI-linked ETFs delivered big Q2 gains as markets rebounded from near bear territory. Winning ETFs include the likes of CRPT, KDEF, URA and PLTM.

content.title: Platinum ETF (PPLT) Hits New 52-Week High
content.summary: PLTM hit a 52-week high as platinum prices soar on supply shortages, Chinese demand, and investment inflows.

content.title: The Fed, the Dollar, and a Key Metal to Watch
content.summary: What's becoming really clear is that whoever the next Federal Reserve Chair will be, easier money is going to have to be their mandate in order to satisfy the boss. Meanwhile, the US dollar continues to fall, particularly against the euro. The Dollar Index (DXY) just hit a fresh multi-year low, explains Peter Boockvar, editor of The Boock Report.

content.title: What's Driving the Rally in Platinum ETFs?
